args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
- corp.itsm: IT service management (incident analysis, asset provisioning) - INTERNAL focus
- sap.ariba: Procurement/supply chain
- sap.s4: ERP (procurement, BOM compliance, asset lifecycle)
- siemens.plm: PLM systems (BOM compliance, engineering change coordination)
- sap.ehs: Safety/EHS (safety compliance automation for engineering changes & materials)
- workday.hcm: HR/HCM
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors - workforce planning
- emarsys.cx: CX/engagement (marketing campaigns, vendor engagement orchestration)
- my.mes: MES (manufacturing execution, production change, quality monitoring)
- sap.crm: Sales/CRM (opportunity qualification, sales compensation)
- sap.odm: Entity type taxonomy

KEY FINDINGS:
- SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator (sap.ehs) = primary for safety validation on engineering changes + materials
- BOMComplianceValidator (siemens.plm, my.mes, sap.s4) = BOM-specific compliance validation
- ProductionChangeOrchestrator (my.mes) = production change coordination & work order sequencing

CONFIRMED GAPS:
- No customer issue tracking/case management/support ticketing
- No maintenance management system / service work order tracking for equipment maintenance & regulatory compliance logging
- Landscape lacks dedicated PM (Plant Maintenance) or service work order capability for general equipment/regulatory tracking

args.reason: The landscape lacks a dedicated maintenance management or service work order tracking system to log equipment changes and regulatory compliance service work orders.
